github_user_identity.description: Direct GitHub user identity with immutable numeric ID and canonical lowercase login display.

frozen_at_utc.description: Must be between source_date_epoch and 72 hours after it; enforced by the verifier.

evidence_completed_at_utc.description: Must be at or after frozen_at_utc and no more than 14 days later; enforced by the verifier.

observed_at_utc.description: Must fall inclusively between candidate frozen_at_utc and evidence_completed_at_utc; enforced by the verifier.
